facts.description: List of metadata entries (exactly one for the chunk)

who.description: People involved with relationships. 'N/A' if general.

fact_type.description: 'world' = objective/external facts. 'assistant' = first-person actions, experiences, or observations by the speaker.

occurred_start.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for events; null otherwise

occurred_end.description: ISO 8601 timestamp for event end; null otherwise

time_expression.description: The temporal phrase exactly as the text wrote it (e.g. 'last spring'); null if none

entities.description: People, places, organizations, objects and concepts the text names

name.description: The entity as the text names it

kind.description: One lowercase word: person, organization, place, ...; null if unclear

labels.description: Classification labels as key/value pairs; [] when no label applies or none are configured

key.description: Label key, or 'group:field' for a structured entity field
